faq: How do I track WhatsApp leads from TikTok Ads?
Connect the ad visit to a traceable link, then record the WhatsApp handoff and conversation milestones.
Why are TikTok clicks different from WhatsApp conversations?
A click, a WhatsApp open and a message are separate stages, so their counts should not be expected to match.
Does a sent event guarantee attribution?
No. A sent event confirms delivery from AdLinker, not platform acceptance, attribution or advertising results.

calc.title: Your volume. Your monthly estimate.
calc.lead: Choose a plan and enter your usage. Rates and credits are filled in automatically.
modeHelp: Includes visits to your landing page.
UV costs are excluded for this journey.
calc.enter: Add your quoted rates to see a total.
calc.incomplete: Complete the rates and enter valid, non-negative values (whole numbers for counts; up to 4 decimals for rates).
calc.funnel: People with deeper conversations cannot exceed the total people who started chatting.
calc.note: An estimate, not a charge. Taxes, exchange fees and any services outside this worksheet are excluded.
calc.formula: Engaged contacts are included in intent contacts; only the deepest stage is billed. Landing-page events deduct the corresponding UV unit rate. Re-engagement is billed separately. Credits cannot make charges negative.
calc.local: Your inputs stay in this browser tab.
calc.advancedHint: Deeper conversations are part of the total people who started chatting; return conversations are separate. Blank optional fields count as 0.
calc.howText: Monthly estimate = plan fee + extra WhatsApp accounts + UV above the free amount + conversations above the credit. If you use direct WhatsApp mode, the UV part is zero.
calc.howDirectText: Monthly estimate = plan fee + extra WhatsApp accounts + conversations above the credit. Direct WhatsApp mode has no UV charge.
calc.usageHint: Enter total monthly usage, including your plan allowance. The estimate includes the plan fee plus any usage above the allowance.
